user_proxy.initiate_chat(assistant, message="plot a chart of NVDA and TESLA stock price change YTD.")

Just a warning for advanced users who already know how to code, this is very VERY basic and doesn't really cover AutoGen as the video title suggests. It explains basic things like IDE, how to install python and git, etc. AutoGen itself is only demoed with 2 basic prompts and no concepts from the framework are explained. I went into the video expecting learning differences between various kinds of entities and communication options in the framework, not this.

Wes, there's nothing wrong with targeting beginners but I'd appreciate if you made it clear that this is made for beginners in the video description (ideally also title). Since the title suggests it is going to be about AutoGen but in reality it's about setting up development environment and installing dependencies, the title jumps into clickbait territory. I've already been burned by a few of your other videos with similar issues and makes me very reluctant to watch any more of your future content. Clickbaits like this might be a way to attract new viewers but you will be losing dedicated fans who have been watching a lot of your content.
